rationale: card #137 root-font migration: removed html { font-size: 62.5% } and divided all rem values by 1.6 to preserve rendered pixels at a 16px consumer root. 1-byte gzip increase from marginally longer decimal tokens (e.g. 0.625rem vs 1rem). Body font-size remains 16px (--font-size: 1rem at 16px root). Em-based typography (h1-h6, .tag.is-small/large, .nav .brand, code/kbd) is unchanged.
